title: Clear leisure without endless readiness

captions.energy: Delaying enjoyment until conditions seem suitable

meaning: Available participation supports leisure when awaiting suitable conditions lets both use a pleasant form already clear to them.
text: A clear leisure form can be ready before the feeling of readiness. The Sun in the physical position of Svadhisthana describes openly joining a pleasant activity. The Hanged Man in energy leans towards delaying enjoyment for more suitable conditions. The Emperor in emotions brings stability within the chosen form. Both may appreciate a familiar simple order. Yet awaiting an ideal perspective each time leaves it in the future. Reliable support helps when enabling participation now instead of confirming that further preparation must precede actual shared joy.

For example, you lay out a favourite quiet game and enjoy discussing the opening move. Doubt arises about having time for the entire game. **Stability can support a beginning without guaranteeing the complete script.** You can agree a small part and freely choose continuation later. Familiar rules already help company. Both need no flawless evening secured beforehand to enjoy available time and hear each other’s interest.

The difficulty is postponing simple participation for complete readiness. Conditions change, time gets discussed again and less playing happens. Stability becomes a requirement instead of support. Another perspective restores an actual step. Both can agree an available scale and finish calmly. A clear form then remains helpful without making pleasure a reward for every doubt disappearing finally. The shared activity can be modest and still feel settled.
